post.description:
Ask a run, and the runs it started, to stop (DUR-05): 202 with the run as it stands
and `cancellation_requested`, the runs whose cancellation this asked for. A queued or
running run is among them and ends `cancelled` once the worker has stopped it. A run
that has finished keeps its own status; if runs it started have not settled (an
acquisition's extraction runs), the answer is still 202 and names only those. A finished
run with none is `RUN_FINISHED`.

get.description:
Recomputed on each read from the stored searches and the held taxonomy (a note says
so if the searches were chosen for another release). The controls are view parameters
only: they change nothing stored and are never limits. Your confirmed salary floor is
applied as a hard filter, with counts; the AI Resilience filter (`min_ai_resilience`,
Any when absent, on the lower end of a reviewed range; unscored occupations included
unless `include_unscored` is false) is a view parameter too, also counted.

post.description:
The written "Why this could suit you" for the slate's first view, as one bounded
run. A slate has at most one call: asking again, from any view, answers 200 with its run.
Only the person's Try again (`retry_failed`) on a run that reached no model starts a new
run (202); on one that sent a request it is refused, `SLATE_ALREADY_EXPLAINED`. The
answer never holds the written text (it is kept as the command's receipt); the
discovery carries it.

200.description: Server-sent events; each `data` is an EventOut, `id` its seq.

job_ids.title: Job Ids
job_ids.description: The jobs this run's sources produced so far.

summary.description: A complete run's outcome per target; none unless it is complete.

partial.title: Partial
partial.description: A search here matched more adverts than it returned (each attempt's adverts_retrieved of total_matching), or did not say how many: a partial result.

no_posting_readable.title: No Posting Readable
no_posting_readable.description: Sources retrieved whose postings could not be read: never 'none found'.

model_extractions.title: Model Extractions
model_extractions.description: Pages handed to a model extraction run; each attempt says how it went.

matching.title: Matching
matching.description: Unknown when a search did not say.

partial.title: Partial
partial.description: Some search matched more than it returned.

AdvertsOut.title: AdvertsOut
AdvertsOut.description: Retrieved n of the total matching, over each search's latest success.

AdzunaQuery.title: AdzunaQuery
AdzunaQuery.description: One bounded search: a role and a place, one page of at most 50 results.

ilo.description: Null: the index does not score the group.

observed_use.title: Observed Use
observed_use.description: Per O*NET-SOC 2019 match from the ESCO to O*NET crosswalk, never averaged.

observed_use_measure.title: Observed Use Measure
observed_use_measure.default: Each task's share of the Claude conversations the Anthropic Economic Index mapped to tasks: observed use, not replacement. A task the release did not observe is not observed, never zero, and never protection.

AiEvidenceState.title: AiEvidenceState
AiEvidenceState.description: What the imported evidence is beside the assessment (fix round 1, review B I1).

synthetic.title: Synthetic
synthetic.description: A scored range here is a synthetic fixture's, never a real assessment.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: In words, when the filter is not at its default.

AiResilienceFilterOut.title: AiResilienceFilterOut
AiResilienceFilterOut.description:
The AI Resilience filter's basis and counts (AIR1-05): the minimum applies to the
lower end of a reviewed range; unscored occupations are included unless you switch
them off, and are never read as 0 or 10.

meaning.title: Meaning
meaning.default: Pressure on demand for human work in this role over five years, including reduced staffing and entry-level hiring: 0 to 10, higher is more resilient. It is not a probability that anyone will lose a job; 0 is not certain elimination and 10 is not a guarantee. Experimental: a range under a reviewed rubric, never a precise score.

evidence_quality.description: The reviewer's grade of the evidence for a published range.

synthetic.title: Synthetic
synthetic.description: This record is a synthetic fixture, never a real assessment; false when the role has no record.

Answer.title: Answer
Answer.description: The five answers the interview pattern distinguishes, each in the same neutral tone.

AnsweredState.title: AnsweredState
AnsweredState.description: A proposal answers a field; it never returns one to "not asked".

AshePeriod.title: AshePeriod
AshePeriod.description:
The period a table gives pay per. A month has no ASHE table, and no figure is ever
converted between periods (annualising needs hours; spec section 5).

cost_nano_usd.title: Cost Nano Usd
cost_nano_usd.description: 0 when no provider call was made (spend_state none); null: unknown.

requests_sent.title: Requests Sent
requests_sent.description: Provider requests in the attempt; a validation repair adds one.

AttemptReason.title: AttemptReason
AttemptReason.description:
Why an attempt was blocked or failed: a label, classified from types and statuses,
never a message. The URL checks' refusals (`addresses.UrlRefusal`) are among them.

Band.title: Band
Band.description:
The rubric's ordinal bands (spec section 5). Never averaged, subtracted or read as
probabilities (AIR1-12).

Basis.title: Basis
Basis.description:
How an answer relates to what the person said (spec section 3: factual confirmations
and inferences are styled differently).

BodyNotKept.title: BodyNotKept
BodyNotKept.description:
Why a body its rights class may keep was not kept: personal details in it could not
be removed (`pages.redact_page`), so only its hash and excerpts are. Each applies to any
script, JSON-LD or not (fix round 3 corrects 0020's wording, re-review 3 A R3-1).

CandidateOption.title: CandidateOption
CandidateOption.description:
An option whose planned outcome maps to the gap's row: "expected to address", never a
recommendation, and never a reason the gap is closed.

discovery_id.title: Discovery Id
discovery_id.description: The discovery that suggested it, if any.

ChooseTarget.title: ChooseTarget
ChooseTarget.description:
Make an ESCO occupation one of the targets: added, or in place of `replaces` (a
target title it is the occupation for).

text.title: Text
text.description: The model's own words (or the demo explainer's), at most 240 characters with no quotation of their own: not checked against any source. Only the quotations beside it were checked.

ClaimSpan.title: ClaimSpan
ClaimSpan.description: A SourceClaim's location: offsets into the hashed text, or a JSON pointer.

Confidence.title: Confidence
Confidence.description: Categorical support from the source, never a model-generated probability.

ConnectionCheckResult.title: ConnectionCheckResult
ConnectionCheckResult.description:
What the model proposes for the synthetic persona. Structurally valid is not true.

Lengths are checked by a validator rather than schema keywords, so the JSON schema sent
to Meta stays within strict mode (Meta then enforces the structure itself).

ConversationMode.title: ConversationMode
ConversationMode.description: The tone the person chose (spec section 4, "Uncertainty and emotional comfort").

Coverage.title: Coverage
Coverage.description: The latest outcome of each source tried (pasted text is not a source tried).

CredentialOut.title: CredentialOut
CredentialOut.description: Metadata only. No endpoint ever returns key material, or any part of it.

DataMode.title: DataMode
DataMode.description: Recorded on every workspace and run (Global Constraint 5, plan section 2).

edits.title: Edits
edits.description: The person's own answers for fields this turn proposed, saved instead of those proposals (as direct entries) in the same version as the accepted ones.

DecideTurn.title: DecideTurn
DecideTurn.description:
Which proposals to apply. A hard-constraint field is applied only if it is also named
in `confirm_hard_constraints`; proposals not accepted are recorded as rejected.

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The profile version the decision created; null when it changed nothing.

DecisionResult.title: DecisionResult
DecisionResult.description:
The decision and the resulting profile. The proposals are read from the turn: this
response is stored as the command's receipt, and model output is kept sealed.

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The profile version it read, pinned.

explanation.description: Its slate's written explanation; null: never asked for.

DiscoveryOut.title: DiscoveryOut
DiscoveryOut.description:
One discovery. `run` is authoritative for its state; `proposal` exists only once the
run is complete, and a failed run's failure class says why there is none.

origin.description: fixture: the deterministic demo proposer (synthetic), never a live model.

DiscoveryProposalOut.title: DiscoveryProposalOut
DiscoveryProposalOut.description: The validated searches. They name no suggestion: the slate is computed from them.

target.title: Target
target.description: One of the profile's target titles.

warning_acknowledged.title: Warning Acknowledged
warning_acknowledged.description: The person read that relaxing an employer's requirement may leave the plan unable to satisfy those postings.

EditRow.title: EditRow
EditRow.description: Set a row's importance, or challenge its source, at the checkpoint.

EmployerCheck.title: EmployerCheck
EmployerCheck.description: A posting's own essential requirement: check it against that posting before applying.

EmptyReason.title: EmptyReason
EmptyReason.description:
Why a listing has no vacancy (STATE-02): never a bare empty list. Only
`none_found_in_sources_checked` says the sources read held none, and only an API's own
empty answer can give it (fix round 2, review B N1); a page model extraction read and
found no advert on gives `no_posting_found_by_model`, never that (ruling 9).

EntryMode.title: EntryMode
EntryMode.description: How the person chose to start (spec section 3, the You chapter).

ErrorStage.title: ErrorStage
ErrorStage.description: Which part of the product the failure affects.

EventOut.title: EventOut
EventOut.description: One status event. The stream's SSE `id` is `seq`; reconnect with Last-Event-ID.

EvidenceContext.title: EvidenceContext
EvidenceContext.description: Where it was done: transferable evidence from any of these counts.

EvidenceOut.title: EvidenceOut
EvidenceOut.description: One of the person's confirmed answers, quoted.

EvidenceQuality.title: EvidenceQuality
EvidenceQuality.description:
The reviewer's grade of the evidence for the allowed range (spec section 18's
"evidence quality"; the words are provisional, R6).

occupations.title: Occupations
occupations.description: Pooled occupations your excluded titles removed.

families.title: Families
families.description: Pooled occupations your excluded kinds of work removed.

ExclusionReason.title: ExclusionReason
ExclusionReason.description: Why a proposed page is not a candidate: the URL checks' refusals, or these.

can_retry.title: Can Retry
can_retry.description: The run failed before any request reached a model, so the person's Try again (`retry_failed`) may start the note afresh. False once a request was sent: the slate has had its one call, and Suggest again makes a new slate.

ExplanationRunOut.title: ExplanationRunOut
ExplanationRunOut.description:
A slate explanation's run, as asking for it answers: never what it wrote, since a
command's answer is kept as its receipt and model output is kept sealed. The discovery
(`GET .../discoveries/{id}`) carries the written text.

ExposureGradient.title: ExposureGradient
ExposureGradient.description: The occupation's exposure category in the 2025 index (Table 5 of the paper).

Extraction.title: Extraction
Extraction.description:
Why a retrieved source gave no posting that could be published. Only an API's own
empty answer (`no_matching_adverts`: Adzuna matched none) says no vacancy was there. A
fetched page's structured data holding no posting says nothing about its HTML, so
`no_job_posting` is unread too (fix round 2, review B N1): never "none found" (GC6).

ExtractionNotRun.title: ExtractionNotRun
ExtractionNotRun.description:
Why a page model extraction may read was not handed to it (`nessa.evidence.
extraction_runs`): the page stays `no_posting_readable`, never "none found".

FieldEdit.title: FieldEdit
FieldEdit.description:
The person's own answer for a field a proposal named. Typing it is their explicit
choice, as in a direct edit, so a limit edited here needs no separate confirmation.

FloorUnknown.title: FloorUnknown
FloorUnknown.description: Why pay could not be compared with the floor; each is kept, and counted.

FreshnessOut.title: FreshnessOut
FreshnessOut.description:
How current a source's data is, from its last successful retrieval (spec section 11).
A failed refresh moves `last_attempt_at` only.

GateKind.title: GateKind
GateKind.description: The protected gate types (spec section 8): a preference toggle never removes one.

title.title: Title
title.description: A search hypothesis until ESCO is found to hold it.

measure.title: Measure
measure.default: Technical potential of generative AI to perform the ISCO-08 group's tasks, 0 to 1 (the mean and spread of its task scores): never a prediction of job loss, and the group's, not this occupation's alone.

InputRoute.title: InputRoute
InputRoute.description: How a source reached Nessa. Pasted text is its own route, never a retrieval.

employer.title: Employer
employer.description: Null when the advert does not name the employer.

salary_confirmed.title: Salary Confirmed
salary_confirmed.description: True only for pay the source advertises.

exemplar.title: Exemplar
exemplar.description: The person's pasted example of a target: never a live vacancy.

JobOut.title: JobOut
JobOut.description:
A canonical job: the values of its newest full copy, and every source copy. Unknown
values are null, never zero; predicted pay is never advertised pay.

items.title: Items
items.description: Vacancies and the person's examples, newest first.

total_jobs.title: Total Jobs
total_jobs.description: Distinct vacancies your salary floor kept: a multi-city job counts once; an example never does.

salary_floor.description: What your confirmed salary floor left out and kept; null with none.

exemplars.title: Exemplars
exemplars.description: The person's pasted examples: never vacancies.

city_counts.title: City Counts
city_counts.description: Vacancies appearing in each city; a multi-city job appears in each.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Sources tried (pasted text is not one), by their latest attempt's outcome; a source retrieved whose postings could not be read is no_posting_readable, and a page model extraction read and found no advert on is no_posting_found_by_model.

adverts.description: For job searches: the adverts retrieved of those matching.

empty_reason.description: When there are no vacancies, why: never a bare empty list (STATE-02).

acquisition_model_spend.description: The most the next acquisition may spend on the person's key, a maximum shown before it starts (MODEL-08); none for a demo workspace, which never calls a model.

JobPage.title: JobPage
JobPage.description:
A page of jobs, with counts that never double count a multi-city job and coverage
that says how many sources were checked. An empty page says why (STATE-02).

label.title: Label
label.description: null when a hidden (search-only) label matched.

Marker.title: Marker
Marker.description: ONS's markers for a value it does not publish (Table 15's key).

MatchType.title: MatchType
MatchType.description: The crosswalk's SKOS match types: how close an O*NET occupation is to its ESCO one.

required.title: Required
required.description: In the target definition: a protected gate, or essential or disputed.

state.description: no_posting_found: the page was read and no job advert was found on it, which is not evidence that there are no vacancies.

not_run.description: Why no extraction run was started.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: The extraction run, if one was started.

ModelExtractionOut.title: ModelExtractionOut
ModelExtractionOut.description:
How model extraction went for a retrieved page whose structured data gave no posting
(fix round 2). Its claims are `validation: model`; nothing here says there is no
vacancy.

ModelExtractionState.title: ModelExtractionState
ModelExtractionState.description: How model extraction went for a page it may read (fix round 2, rulings 9-10).

model_id.title: Model Id
model_id.description: The model the workspace's extraction runs pin.

model_runs.title: Model Runs
model_runs.description: At most this many extraction runs per acquisition.

per_run_nano_usd.title: Per Run Nano Usd
per_run_nano_usd.description: The most one run spends without a worker crash: every attempt it may make, each at its reservation's bounds.

worst_case_nano_usd.title: Worst Case Nano Usd
worst_case_nano_usd.description: The most the acquisition spends without a worker crash: model_runs x per_run_nano_usd.

hard_maximum_nano_usd.title: Hard Maximum Nano Usd
hard_maximum_nano_usd.description: The most the acquisition can ever spend, a worker crash included: model_runs x the workspace's per-run spend limit, past which a run never reserves.

ModelSpendOut.title: ModelSpendOut
ModelSpendOut.description:
The most one acquisition may spend on the person's model key, before it starts
(MODEL-08; computed in deterministic code), as two maxima, never an expected cost. Each
page whose structured data gives no posting may be read by an extraction run on the
workspace's model, at most `model_runs` per acquisition. Without a worker crash, each
run makes at most every attempt its retry owner allows (a provider outage is retried),
each reserving its worst case (`worst_case_nano_usd`). A crash can give a run fresh
attempts, but never a reservation past the workspace's run limit
(`hard_maximum_nano_usd`).

ModelledPayUnavailable.title: ModelledPayUnavailable
ModelledPayUnavailable.description: Why an occupation has no modelled pay (it is then unknown, never zero).

Money.title: Money
Money.description: A payment, fee, cap or balance: never negative.

NotIncluded.title: NotIncluded
NotIncluded.description: Why a pooled occupation is not on the slate ("show why this wasn't included").

NotIncludedOut.title: NotIncludedOut
NotIncludedOut.description: A pooled occupation the slate does not show, and why.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Your cities' regions: ASHE is regional.

text_rank.title: Text Rank
text_rank.description: PostgreSQL ts_rank_cd; orders this result only.

OccupationNote.title: OccupationNote
OccupationNote.description: Why a matrix has no ESCO seed.

concept_id.title: Concept Id
concept_id.description: Nessa's internal concept ID (stable per URI).

regulated.title: Regulated
regulated.description: null: ESCO records no regulation note.

isco_groups.title: Isco Groups
isco_groups.description: ISCO-08 from the major group down to the unit group (the grouping pivot).

full_text_total.title: Full Text Total
full_text_total.description: null: full-text search did not run (the query has no searchable word but matched a label), which is not the same as no match.

OccupationSearchOut.title: OccupationSearchOut
OccupationSearchOut.description:
Exact label matches (all of them, when several occupations share a label), then
ranked full-text matches. `full_text_total` counts every other full-text match, so a
limited page is never mistaken for the whole result.

in_release.title: In Release
in_release.description: False: the release lists no task for this code.

PackLabel.title: PackLabel
PackLabel.description: The option pack's date and review states, shown wherever its records are (R9).

PackTargetNote.title: PackTargetNote
PackTargetNote.description: Why a matrix has no pack target although one could apply.

PartialCompleteness.title: PartialCompleteness
PartialCompleteness.description:
How complete a run's streamed reply is (spec section 18: partial results carry
completeness and freshness). Streamed text is never validated and never a result.

completeness.description: none: no text yet; streaming: the reply so far; stopped: this attempt's reply stopped, but the run goes on and may stream again or still be superseded (not final); incomplete: final, the run ended without a validated output; superseded: a validated output is stored, so read the proposal's reply once the run is complete.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Matches the run.partial_updated event that announced it.

text.title: Text
text.description: The reply so far; null when none or superseded.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the text was last written (freshness).

PartialReplyOut.title: PartialReplyOut
PartialReplyOut.description:
The turn's reply as it streams: unvalidated text, never a proposal. The turn's run
state and, once complete, its proposal are authoritative.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Where the person copied it from, as a reference only.

PasteText.title: PasteText
PasteText.description:
A posting the person pasted: their own example of a target (spec section 7, "User
examples versus discovered corpus").

PayBasis.title: PayBasis
PayBasis.description:
Advertised (stated by the source), predicted (a provider's estimate, such as
Adzuna's `salary_is_predicted`) and unknown stay distinct (spec section 6).

PayBenchmarkOut.title: PayBenchmarkOut
PayBenchmarkOut.description: An official pay benchmark (ONS ASHE): a unit group's pay in a work region.

amount.description: Gross pay; null when ONS withholds it.

withheld.description: ONS's marker for a withheld value.

cv.title: Cv
cv.description: This statistic's own coefficient of variation, %.

reliability.description: ONS's quality band for this statistic.

PlaceList.title: PlaceList
PlaceList.description:
The finite list of English cities a work area can name. A city is geography only:
it never implies residence or the right to work.

hits.title: Hits
hits.description: Occupations this query found (bounded per query).

PostingCitation.title: PostingCitation
PostingCitation.description: One posting's requirement row behind a matrix row, as the pack records it.

PreferencesOut.title: PreferencesOut
PreferencesOut.description:
How the person chose to start and to be interviewed, and whether it is paused. Null:
not chosen yet (the interviewer then keeps to the practical mode).

Prevalence.title: Prevalence
Prevalence.description:
Distinct vacancies naming the row. `full_text` counts vacancies with a full
description; `snippet` counts the rest (snippets, or a description of unknown kind):
snippet prevalence, never evidence of absence and never requirement frequency.

ProfileDocument.title: ProfileDocument
ProfileDocument.description: A stored profile version's content: each field with the source that established it.

ProfileField.title: ProfileField
ProfileField.description: The only names a proposal may use: the profile's own fields.

enjoyed_tasks.description: Tasks the person enjoys (interest), at most 8.

confident_tasks.description: Tasks the person believes they can do (confidence), at most 8.

evidenced_tasks.description: Tasks the person has evidence they can do, at most 8.

work_style.description: How the person says they like to work (optional), at most 8: it informs suggestions and never excludes any kind of work.

minimum_salary.description: The lowest gross pay the person will accept, with its period: a hard limit, set only by their confirmation. Applied as a hard filter, with counts: a suggestion or a vacancy is left out only when the highest pay it states in this period is below it; unknown, predicted or other-period pay is never below it.

ProfileInput.title: ProfileInput
ProfileInput.description: What a client submits: states and values only.

version.title: Version
version.description: 0 means nothing has been saved yet.

origin.description: fixture: the deterministic demo interviewer (synthetic), never a live model.

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The profile version the proposals were made for.

ProposalOut.title: ProposalOut
ProposalOut.description: A complete, validated interview output. Nothing in it is saved until decided.

value.title: Value
value.description: The proposed answer, typed as the field's input; null unless provided. A list is the complete list after the change: accepting it replaces the field's list.

basis.description: stated: the value appears in the cited messages (checked by the server); inferred: implied, or not found in them.

message_ids.title: Message Ids
message_ids.description: The person's messages it rests on.

hard_constraint.title: Hard Constraint
hard_constraint.description: A limit or target: applied only if named in confirm_hard_constraints.

concept_kind.title: Concept Kind
concept_kind.description: provisional: Nessa's own concept for a verified title, never an ESCO one.

ProvisionalConceptOut.title: ProvisionalConceptOut
ProvisionalConceptOut.description: A title the person verified that ESCO does not hold: no ESCO URI, no ISCO group.

Qualification.title: Qualification
Qualification.description: Why a result is not unqualified. M0 matrices are always provisional.

QueryChannel.title: QueryChannel
QueryChannel.description:
The model's discovery channels (spec section 4, DIV-1's five channels). Nessa adds
the person's current role and their own target titles itself.

answer_field.description: Which of your answers, for a quotation of yours.

record_part.description: Which part of ESCO's record, for a quotation of ESCO's.

text.title: Text
text.description: The source's own words, checked as an exact span of it.

RecordEvidence.title: RecordEvidence
RecordEvidence.description: An answer about a skill: the level is chosen against `rubric_version`'s anchors.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: Checked at its source: a register, a right to work check.

RecordStatement.title: RecordStatement
RecordStatement.description: Whether the person holds a credential, experience or eligibility requirement.

ReferenceLabel.title: ReferenceLabel
ReferenceLabel.description: The rubrics, crosswalks and gate types' version and review state.

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: A synthetic or reduced test copy: never real evidence.

ReferenceReleaseOut.title: ReferenceReleaseOut
ReferenceReleaseOut.description:
A pinned reference dataset's import manifest (TAX1-04): show its attribution wherever
its figures appear.

ReleaseRefOut.title: ReleaseRefOut
ReleaseRefOut.description: The ESCO release the slate searched; show the attribution and adaptation with it.

Reliability.title: Reliability
Reliability.description: ONS's quality bands for an estimate's coefficient of variation (CV).

Retention.title: Retention
Retention.description: What a workspace keeps of a source's body.

to_version.title: To Version
to_version.description: An earlier version; 0 is the empty profile.

RevertProfile.title: RevertProfile
RevertProfile.description: Restore an earlier version's answers, each with its own source, as a new version.

RightsClass.title: RightsClass
RightsClass.description: The page classes of the session 1 rights policy (H-06; `corpus/README.md`).

RowEvidence.title: RowEvidence
RowEvidence.description: What one row reads from the evidence on its subject, against its own rubric.

RowKind.title: RowKind
RowKind.description:
Credentials, experience and eligibility are distinct from learnable skills (spec
section 8): only skills and tasks have levels.

model_id.title: Model Id
model_id.description: None for a run that calls no model (acquisition).

cancel_requested_at.title: Cancel Requested At
cancel_requested_at.description: When the person asked to cancel it; the run ends `cancelled` once the worker has stopped it.

output.description: A connection check's result. An interview turn's proposals are read through the turn (`GET .../interview/turns/{turn_id}`).

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The profile version the run read, pinned at submission.

cancellation_requested.title: Cancellation Requested
cancellation_requested.description: The runs whose cancellation this asked for: the run itself while it is queued or running, and every run it started that has not settled (an acquisition's extraction runs), or both. Each ends `cancelled` once the worker has stopped it.

RunCancelOut.title: RunCancelOut
RunCancelOut.description:
A cancel's answer (DUR-05): the run as it stands, and the runs whose cancellation the
request asked for (review C-1 N2).

model_id.title: Model Id
model_id.description: None for a run that calls no model (acquisition).

cancel_requested_at.title: Cancel Requested At
cancel_requested_at.description: When the person asked to cancel it; the run ends `cancelled` once the worker has stopped it.

output.description: A connection check's result. An interview turn's proposals are read through the turn (`GET .../interview/turns/{turn_id}`).

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The profile version the run read, pinned at submission.

RunOut.title: RunOut
RunOut.description: The authoritative run state. A failed or unavailable run never carries an output.

Salary.title: Salary
Salary.description:
Pay as the source gives it, before any normalisation. GBP in minor units; a period
the source does not state stays None (never assumed to be a year).

period.description: Annual unless the person says otherwise.

SalaryFloor.title: SalaryFloor
SalaryFloor.description:
The lowest gross pay the person will accept, as they gave it: its period is kept and
never converted, because annualising needs working hours (spec section 5).

left_out.title: Left Out
left_out.description: Suggestions left out because their pay is below it.

kept_pay_unknown.title: Kept Pay Unknown
kept_pay_unknown.description: Kept: their pay could not be compared.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The counts in words, for display.

SalaryFloorOut.title: SalaryFloorOut
SalaryFloorOut.description:
Your confirmed salary floor, applied as a hard filter: a suggestion is left out only
when official pay for it (ASHE through a reviewed UK SOC mapping, the 90th percentile in
every region of your cities) is below it. Unknown pay is never treated as below it.

SalaryInput.title: SalaryInput
SalaryInput.description:
A new answer: a floor is more than £0. Checked on input only, so a version stored
before the rule still opens (read, history, export).

SalaryPeriod.title: SalaryPeriod
SalaryPeriod.description: The period a source states pay per (the profile's salary floor has its own).

grounded.title: Grounded
grounded.description: The search actually returned this URL.

SearchEmptyReason.title: SearchEmptyReason
SearchEmptyReason.description:
Why a search proposes no candidate. None of them is evidence that there is no vacancy:
only that this search found no page Nessa could check.

url.title: Url
url.description: A checked http(s) URL; none when the checks refused it.

refused_host.title: Refused Host
refused_host.description: A refused URL's host as plain text, never a link.

SearchExcluded.title: SearchExcluded
SearchExcluded.description:
A proposed page that is not a candidate. A URL the checks refuse is never kept as a
URL (it could be `javascript:`): only its host, as plain text.

proposal.description: None until the run is complete.

SearchOut.title: SearchOut
SearchOut.description:
A source search: candidate pages only, never claims. The person chooses which to
acquire; a candidate the search did not return is marked ungrounded.

source_hosts.title: Source Hosts
source_hosts.description: The hosts of the pages the search returned.

empty_reason.description: Why there is no candidate: never evidence that there are no vacancies.

SearchProposal.title: SearchProposal
SearchProposal.description: A source search's validated output: candidates only, never claims.

SetPreferences.title: SetPreferences
SetPreferences.description: The whole set of preferences; null means not chosen.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.description: Stop or pause the questions; false resumes them.

expected_version.title: Expected Version
expected_version.description: 0 while the defaults have never been saved.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: The minimum inputs: a target and four practical answers.

SketchOut.title: SketchOut
SketchOut.description:
The early requirement sketch: never a feasible or optimal route, never priced or
dated. Every step stays unresolved until a later chapter resolves it.

SkippedOut.title: SkippedOut
SkippedOut.description:
A URL not fetched by this request: another run is fetching it (`in_flight`), or it
failed recently and waits out its back-off (`backing_off`, until `retry_at`).

SlateChannel.title: SlateChannel
SlateChannel.description: How a candidate was found: the model's channels plus Nessa's own.

can_retry.title: Can Retry
can_retry.description: The run failed before any request reached a model, so the person's Try again (`retry_failed`) may start the note afresh. False once a request was sent: the slate has had its one call, and Suggest again makes a new slate.

SlateExplanationOut.title: SlateExplanationOut
SlateExplanationOut.description:
The written "Why this could suit you" of a discovery's slate: at most one per
discovery, whatever view is shown. `run` is authoritative for its state; `written`
exists only once the run is complete, and a failed run's failure class says why there is
none. It changes no suggestion; the deterministic provenance beside it (each
suggestion's linked answers, searches and ESCO source) is what exports cite.

family_limit.title: Family Limit
family_limit.description: At most this many from one kind of work.

fewer_reasons.title: Fewer Reasons
fewer_reasons.description: Why there are fewer than six, if there are.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: How a control changed the slate, in words.

salary_floor.description: Your confirmed salary floor's effect, as a hard filter; null with none.

beyond_pool_limit.title: Beyond Pool Limit
beyond_pool_limit.description: Occupations found past the pool's bound.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Every search that ran, with its hits.

unsupported_hypotheses.title: Unsupported Hypotheses
unsupported_hypotheses.description: Titles Nessa thought of that ESCO does not list: never suggested.

SlateOut.title: SlateOut
SlateOut.description:
A varied slate of up to six career hypotheses from the discovery's searches, computed
deterministically each time it is read, with every count that explains it.

index_entries.title: Index Entries
index_entries.description: Index titles of the ISCO group coded to it.

title_match.title: Title Match
title_match.description: An ESCO label is one of its index titles.

benchmarks.title: Benchmarks
benchmarks.description: ASHE for this unit group in your cities' regions: about the unit group, not this occupation, unless the mapping is reviewed.

reason.description: Why it was blocked or failed: a label, never text.

extraction.description: Why a retrieved source gave no publishable posting. Only no_matching_adverts (an API's own empty answer) says none matched; the others say its postings could not be read from its structured data.

model_extraction.description: For a page whose structured data gave no posting: its model extraction.

content_sha256.title: Content Sha256
content_sha256.description: Of what was kept, personal details removed.

body_not_kept.description: Why a body its class may keep was not kept: personal details in it could not be removed.

total_matching.title: Total Matching
total_matching.description: For a search: the adverts it matched.

cost_nano_usd.title: Cost Nano Usd
cost_nano_usd.description: 0 for page fetches and Adzuna's free tier.

SourceAttemptOut.title: SourceAttemptOut
SourceAttemptOut.description:
One try to obtain a source (spec section 18, SourceAttempt). Blocked and failed tries
are kept with their reason; a URL never carries a credential.

validation.description: model: a model read it from the page's text and deterministic code approved it (its quote is a span of that text, whose hash the span gives).

SourceClaimOut.title: SourceClaimOut
SourceClaimOut.description: One field value with the span that supports it (spec section 18, SourceClaim).

discovery_id.title: Discovery Id
discovery_id.description: An occupation choice: the discovery that suggested it.

SourceOut.title: SourceOut
SourceOut.description:
Where an answer came from. A conversation source also names the turn that proposed
it, the person's messages it cites and its basis; `recorded_by` confirmed it.

SourceSpan.title: SourceSpan
SourceSpan.description:
Where a value is in its source: character offsets into the source's text (a page's
decoded HTML, the pasted text, or the page's visible text that model extraction read,
whose hash is `source_sha256`), or for an API response a JSON pointer; with a minimal
excerpt either way, so a reviewer can find what supported the value at retrieval time.

period_committed_nano_usd.title: Period Committed Nano Usd
period_committed_nano_usd.description: Known costs plus the full reservation of every call whose cost is unknown.

SpendOut.title: SpendOut
SpendOut.description: Provider spend in integer nano-USD (Meta bills in USD; never a float).

SubmitAcquisition.title: SubmitAcquisition
SubmitAcquisition.description: Up to ten URLs, or one Adzuna search: never both.

retry_failed.title: Retry Failed
retry_failed.description: The person's explicit Try again: start the note afresh if its run failed before any request reached a model (`can_retry`). Never sent automatically.

SubmitExplanation.title: SubmitExplanation
SubmitExplanation.description: Ask for the written explanation of a discovery's slate, made against these answers.

SubmitRun.title: SubmitRun
SubmitRun.description:
`POST /runs` starts the runs that need no input; interview turns have their own
endpoint, which records the person's message with the run.

acquisition.description: None when every URL was skipped: nothing was started.

family.description: The kind of work: its ISCO-08 minor group.

matched_queries.title: Matched Queries
matched_queries.description: The query IDs that found it.

workday.title: Workday
workday.description: ESCO's description of the work, shortened.

try_it.title: Try It
try_it.description: Low-cost ways to test the idea before committing.

SuggestionOut.title: SuggestionOut
SuggestionOut.description:
A career hypothesis (spec section 4's `CareerSuggestion`): an ESCO occupation, the
answers that found it and ESCO's facts about it, in words. Becoming a target needs the
person's choice (`POST .../targets`).

review_status.title: Review Status
review_status.description: How far the policy is reviewed (gate H-12).

message.title: Message
message.description: Says whether the message was sent.

SupportNoteOut.title: SupportNoteOut
SupportNoteOut.description:
The support panel, shown beside a message that triggers the support screen
(`nessa.profile.safety`), whether the send was accepted or refused. Kept apart from
career suitability. Derived from the request on every response, a replay included;
never stored, not even in the idempotency receipt.

checked_on.title: Checked On
checked_on.description: When the service's own page was last checked.

url.title: Url
url.description: A checked http(s) URL; none for a query or a refusal.

refusal.description: Why a submitted URL was refused unfetched.

refused_host.title: Refused Host
refused_host.description: A refused URL's host as plain text, never a link; the URL is not kept.

status.description: not_attempted: its run ended before it.

occupations.title: Occupations
occupations.description: The ESCO occupation, or the several that share the title (choose one).

close_matches.title: Close Matches
close_matches.description: For a title ESCO does not hold: the nearest occupations by full text.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: ESCO's essential skills, the first few.

adaptation.title: Adaptation
adaptation.description: How this import adapts the release: it is marked so.

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: A reduced test copy: never the catalogue a person sees.

repeated_rows_collapsed.title: Repeated Rows Collapsed
repeated_rows_collapsed.description: Concept rows the release repeats with only their modified date changed, imported once (part of the transformation).

TaxonomyReleaseOut.title: TaxonomyReleaseOut
TaxonomyReleaseOut.description:
The import manifest of the ESCO release in use (TAX1-04). Show `attribution` and
`adaptation` wherever ESCO content appears (ESCO's two reuse conditions).

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The profile version the message was sent with.

TurnOut.title: TurnOut
TurnOut.description:
One interview turn. `run` is authoritative for its state: `proposal` exists only when
the run is complete, and a failed run's failure class says why there is none.

TurnRefusedOut.title: TurnRefusedOut
TurnRefusedOut.description:
A refused send. When its message triggers the support screen, the panel comes with
the refusal, since the message was screened before anything could refuse it.

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The profile version the message was sent with.

TurnSubmittedOut.title: TurnSubmittedOut
TurnSubmittedOut.description: A new turn, with the support panel when its message holds a risk stem.

proposed_soc_code.title: Proposed Soc Code
proposed_soc_code.description: A single or title match: unreviewed.

UkSocMappingOut.title: UkSocMappingOut
UkSocMappingOut.description: ESCO occupation to UK SOC 2020, with every candidate kept (TAX1-02).

UrlRefusal.title: UrlRefusal
UrlRefusal.description: Why a URL is not fetched. Each is a policy refusal, recorded as a blocked attempt.

left_out.title: Left Out
left_out.description: Vacancies left out: their advertised pay is below it.

VacancySalaryFloorOut.title: VacancySalaryFloorOut
VacancySalaryFloorOut.description:
Your confirmed salary floor, applied to vacancies as a hard filter: a vacancy is left
out only when the highest pay it advertises in the floor's period, in GBP, is below it
(advertised pay is read as gross). Predicted, unstated or other-period pay is never
below it: those are kept and counted by reason.

ValidationState.title: ValidationState
ValidationState.description: How a claim's value was established. Only deterministic code approves a value.

WorkState.title: WorkState
WorkState.description: One state vocabulary (spec section 3, STATE-01). A failure is never an empty success.

discoveries.title: Discoveries
discoveries.description: Oldest first; slates are recomputed. A discovery's provenance is its searches and the answers they cite; a written explanation is never cited as one.

fixture.title: Fixture
fixture.description: The named fixture workspace that `make reset-demo` resets.

last_event_seq.title: Last Event Seq
last_event_seq.description: The workspace's latest status-event sequence number when read: pass it as Last-Event-ID to receive only what happens after this read.

origin.description: fixture: the deterministic demo explainer (synthetic), never a live model.

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The discovery's pinned version it quotes.

release.title: Release
release.description: The ESCO release whose records it quotes.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: The first view's suggestions (balanced, no exclusions), in its order. A suggestion another view shows that is not here has no written explanation.

HTTPBearer.description: A Firebase ID token from the Auth emulator.
